experiment_local_cost.note: Warmups excluded from paired latency/quality averages but retained in total experimental compute cost; cgroup CPU includes probes and any concurrent service work.

failure_policy: No automatic retry or replacement. Availability and wall/CPU costs include all measured attempts; quality uses only paired successes and reports missing pairs.

accepted_translation_serving_cost.provenance: Cost of preparing the accepted frozen translations; historical reference only when this run reuses translations. Actual current-run charges are in all/translation/translation_revision.

api_cost.billing_note: Published official price estimate from returned usage, not invoice; report off-peak/peak range, excludes electricity/depreciation and no assumed local per-token API charge. Only calls in this run are included; serving B needs no extra translation call if upstream translation already exists.
